Days & months

Talk about the days, months, and dates in Thai. This topic covers the weekdays — all beginning with วัน, like วันจันทร์ (Monday) and วันอาทิตย์ (Sunday) — plus เมื่อวาน (yesterday), พรุ่งนี้ (tomorrow), and arranging appointments, weekends, and how often you do something. It runs through all twelve months and the festivals that anchor them — สงกรานต์ (Thai New Year, in April), วันแม่ (Mother's Day in August), Loi Krathong — then dates and Thailand's พ.ศ. (Buddhist Era) years. All 37 sentences come with native-speed audio, English translations, and word-by-word notes, so the calendar vocabulary sinks in by ear.

37 sentences · Click each sentence to reveal Thai, English, and notes
